name: analyst_recom_null_rate_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: ANALYST_RECOM_NULL_RATE_20261107 — LQ-20261107-185: analyst_consensus_history.recom_score had only a
1-5 range contract, and a range rule treats NULL as absent rather than invalid, so a producer that stopped
writing the column entirely passed it vacuously. Measured live 2026-11-07: 1,140 of 1,140 finviz rows in the
last 30 days NULL, last non-NULL value 2026-08-18, last finviz row written 2026-10-20. Cause: after the
2026-09-13 header-keyed rewrite no configured Finviz view returns a 'Recom' column. This gate pins the
null_rate rule (with min_rows, so an empty window cannot fail open), the optional any-view Recom column map,
the writer's skip/presence counts, and a backfill that classifies every NULL row and has no write path.
